voice.zh: 独自出门，去见一位朋友。
voice.en: Heading out on your own to meet a friend.

voice.zh: 对聋人和重听人士，重要的环境提醒，也应有触觉的入口。
voice.en: For deaf and hard-of-hearing people, important cues should be accessible through touch.

voice.zh: SoundBridge，让重要的提醒被感知。
voice.en: SoundBridge. Make important cues easier to notice.

voice.zh: 共享步道上，身后传来车铃。
voice.en: On a shared path, a bicycle bell rings behind you.

voice.zh: 拟议系统识别声音类别，触发三次短振，并显示车铃图标和文字。
voice.en: The proposed system recognizes the sound, then shows a bicycle-bell alert with three short pulses.

voice.zh: 提醒提供线索，接下来，观察周围。
voice.en: The alert offers a cue. Next, check your surroundings.

voice.zh: 她停在步道一侧，转头确认骑行者的位置。
voice.en: She pauses at the side of the path and checks where the cyclist is.

voice.zh: 确认空间后，让对方通过，再继续自己的行程。
voice.en: After checking the space, she lets the cyclist pass and continues.

voice.zh: 选择，由她自己作出。
voice.en: The decision is hers.

voice.zh: 麦克风采集短时声音，转换为频谱特征。
voice.en: Microphones capture short audio windows and convert them into spectral features.

voice.zh: 拟议的本地模型，识别车铃、鸣笛和门铃。
voice.en: The proposed on-device model recognizes bicycle bells, horns and doorbells.

voice.zh: 置信度筛选、连续确认和重复抑制，再决定是否提醒。
voice.en: Confidence checks, temporal confirmation and deduplication determine whether to alert.

voice.zh: 真实环境中的漏报和误报，仍需验证。
voice.en: Missed detections and false alerts still need testing in real environments.

voice.zh: 声音类别映射到振动节奏，再驱动触觉马达。
voice.en: Sound categories map to rhythms that drive the haptic actuator.

voice.zh: 门铃用两组双击，车铃和鸣笛用三次短振。
voice.en: Doorbells use two paired taps; bicycle bells and horns use three short pulses.

voice.zh: 配合图标与文字，不只依赖颜色。
voice.en: Icons and text reinforce the cue, without relying on color alone.

voice.zh: 来向估计，需要多麦克风硬件和校准。
voice.en: Direction estimation requires multiple microphones and calibration.

voice.zh: 比较声音到达的时间差，估计相对手表的大致来向。
voice.en: Arrival-time differences estimate an approximate direction relative to the watch.

voice.zh: 无法可靠判断时，明确显示方向不确定。
voice.en: When the estimate is unreliable, show that the direction is uncertain.

voice.zh: 它不能代替观察，也不保证避开危险。
voice.en: It cannot replace observation or guarantee avoidance of danger.

voice.zh: 拟议状态设计，让暂停、低电量和感知故障清晰可见。
voice.en: The proposed status design makes pause, low battery and sensing faults visible.

voice.zh: 暂停或故障时，明确告知无法提供提醒。
voice.en: When paused or sensing fails, clearly show that alerts are unavailable.

voice.zh: 没有收到提醒，不代表周围没有风险。
voice.en: No alert does not mean there is no risk nearby.

voice.zh: 选择关注的声音，试一试不同的振动强度。
voice.en: Choose the sounds to notice and try different vibration strengths.

voice.zh: 字号也能调整，偏好保存在本地。
voice.en: Adjust text size and store preferences locally.

voice.zh: 与聋人和重听人士共同测试，让提示容易理解。
voice.en: Test together with deaf and hard-of-hearing people to make cues understandable.

voice.zh: 同样的感知流程，也能用于居家门铃提示。
voice.en: The same sensing flow can support doorbell alerts at home.

voice.zh: 振动与文字提示有人来访，让你继续专注自己的生活。
voice.en: Vibration and text signal a visitor while you focus on your day.

voice.zh: 何时回应，由你决定。
voice.en: Choose when to respond.

name: Modes
title: 开启与暂停，都由你掌握

voice.zh: 居家关注门铃，户外关注车铃与鸣笛。
voice.en: Home focuses on doorbells; outdoors on bicycle bells and horns.

voice.zh: 暂停会停止采集与提醒，并持续显示暂停状态。
voice.en: Pausing stops capture and alerts, with a persistent paused indicator.

voice.zh: 准备好了，再恢复感知。
voice.en: Resume awareness when you are ready.

voice.zh: 方案默认本地处理，不保存原始录音。
voice.en: The proposed default is local processing without saving raw recordings.

voice.zh: 可选事件历史，只记录类别与时间，由你管理。
voice.en: Optional event history stores category and time under your control.

voice.zh: 这些目标，需要在最终软硬件中落实。
voice.en: These goals must be implemented in the final hardware and software.

voice.zh: 从独自出门，到与朋友相聚，生活按自己的节奏展开。
voice.en: From heading out alone to meeting a friend, life moves at your own pace.

voice.zh: SoundBridge。让重要的提醒，被及时感知。
voice.en: SoundBridge. Help important cues reach you when they matter.
